about: A federal airport 15 km north-west of Blagoveshchensk and 3.5 km from the border with China. Flights to cities of the Far East, Siberia and to Moscow. New terminal complex of more than 26,000 m², more than 1 million passengers in 2025.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: City bus No. 8А runs from the Univermag stop to the Aeroport stop in 42 minutes, fare 46 ₽. Into town the bus goes to the Magazin Blagoveshchensk stop, about 40 minutes. Several trips a day, timetable varies by day of the week. Because of roadworks on the Blagoveshchensk – Bibikovo road, the airport asks passengers to set off an hour earlier.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Business lounge in the right wing of the departure hall, Level 5, from 5:00 to 17:00. Admits business class passengers, members of airline loyalty programmes, and Grey Wall, Every Lounge, RUS Priority, On pass and Golden Key holders. Others pay 6,000 ₽ for 3 hours, then 550 ₽ per hour, children under 2 free.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Automated left luggage in the right wing of the terminal, Level 1. A standard locker is 200 ₽ per hour or 500 ₽ per day, a large one 300 ₽ per hour or 800 ₽ per day. Baggage wrapping is also there, from 950 ₽ per item.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child room in the right wing of the terminal, Level 2, from 5:00 to 17:00. Children under 7, or under 14 with disabilities, are admitted 3 hours before departure and within an hour after arrival. Passport and ticket required; enter with hand luggage only.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Drop-off and pick-up zone: up to 15 minutes free, 16–60 minutes 600 ₽, then 600 ₽ per hour. Car park Р1 with 600 spaces 2 minutes from the terminal, paid from the first minute: up to 30 minutes 100 ₽, up to an hour 150 ₽, up to 2 hours 250 ₽, up to 24 hours 400 ₽, each further 24 hours 400 ₽.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi‑Fi in the passenger areas of the terminal. Network Goodfly, login with a mobile phone number.
